mapper.select: SELECT profile_id, password_hash, failed_attempts, locked_until FROM user_password_credential WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_password_credential (profile_id, password_hash, password_set_at) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{passwordHash}, NOW(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE user_password_credential SET failed_attempts = 0, locked_until = NULL WHERE profile_id = #{profileId}
